require 'sinatra' require 'json' require 'redis' require 'securerandom' # ML Inference Server - handles model predictions and stores results # Sits behind nginx reverse proxy that sets X-Request-ID class InferenceServer < Sinatra::Base configure do set :redis, Redis.new(url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379/0')) set :show_exceptions, false set :protection, true end helpers do def sanitize_text(input) return '' if input.nil? # Full HTML entity encoding for all user content encode_html(input) end def encode_html(input) return '' if input.nil? input.to_s .gsub('&', '&') .gsub('<', '<') .gsub('>', '>') .gsub('"', '"') .gsub("'", ''') end def validate_model_name(name) return false unless name.is_a?(String) name.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\z/) end # Only accept a well-formed request ID from the proxy header. # Anything malformed or missing is replaced with a server-generated UUID # so untrusted input cannot be used to overwrite arbitrary Redis keys. def current_request_id candidate = env['HTTP_X_REQUEST_ID'] if candidate.is_a?(String) && candidate.length <= 128 && candidate.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\z/) candidate else SecureRandom.uuid end end def store_prediction_result(request_id, model, input_data, result) record = { id: request_id, model: model, input_summary: input_data['description'] || input_data.to_s[0..200], result: result, timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601, client_ip: env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] || request.ip } settings.redis.hset("predictions", request_id, JSON.generate(record)) record end end # Health check endpoint get '/health' do content_type :json { status: 'healthy', version: '2.1.0' }.to_json end # Submit inference request post '/api/v1/predict/:model' do content_type :json model = params[:model] unless validate_model_name(model) halt 400, { error: 'Invalid model name' }.to_json end begin body = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue JSON::ParserError halt 400, { error: 'Invalid JSON body' }.to_json end # Simulate ML inference prediction = run_inference(model, body) record = store_prediction_result(current_request_id, model, body, prediction) status 200 { prediction: prediction, request_id: record[:id] }.to_json end # View prediction history - rendered as HTML dashboard get '/dashboard/predictions' do content_type :html predictions = settings.redis.hgetall("predictions").map do |id, data| JSON.parse(data, symbolize_names: true) end.sort_by { |p| p[:timestamp] }.reverse.first(50) render_dashboard(predictions) end # Get single prediction detail get '/api/v1/predictions/:id' do content_type :json data = settings.redis.hget("predictions", params[:id]) halt 404, { error: 'Not found' }.to_json unless data JSON.parse(data) data end private def run_inference(model, input_data) # Simulated inference - in production this calls TensorFlow Serving / ONNX Runtime features = input_data['features'] || [] { label: features.length > 3 ? 'positive' : 'negative', confidence: 0.85 + (rand * 0.14), model_version: "#{model}-v2.1" } end def render_dashboard(predictions) rows = predictions.map do |pred| # Sanitize user-controllable fields for HTML display safe_model = encode_html(pred[:model]) safe_id = encode_html(pred[:id]) safe_ip = encode_html(pred[:client_ip]) safe_timestamp = encode_html(pred[:timestamp]) # Input summary gets sanitize_text treatment (allows some formatting) safe_summary = sanitize_text(pred[:input_summary]) safe_result = encode_html(pred[:result].to_s) "#{safe_id}#{safe_model}" \ "#{safe_summary}#{safe_result}" \ "#{safe_ip}#{safe_timestamp}" end.join("\n") <<~HTML ML Inference Dashboard

Prediction History

#{rows}
Request IDModelInput Summary ResultClient IPTimestamp
HTML end end
